report_name: SilverFox APT Hits Japanese Manufacturer with Advanced ValleyRAT

threat_actors.name: SilverFox
threat_actors.description: A Chinese-speaking APT group that conducted a sophisticated cyber-espionage campaign against a Japanese industrial manufacturer, utilizing advanced TTPs including DLL sideloading and deploying a dual-layer ValleyRAT payload.
threat_actors.goals: Long-term espionage and intellectual property theft from the manufacturing sector.

attack_patterns.name: Spearphishing Attachment
attack_patterns.description: The attack campaign initiated with invoice-themed spear-phishing emails containing malicious attachments or links.

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: Victims were lured into downloading and executing a malicious file, hosted on legitimate cloud services like QQ and Tencent Cloud, to start the infection chain.

attack_patterns.name: DLL Side-Loading
attack_patterns.description: The SilverFox group abused legitimate executables, `ConvertToPDF.exe` and `PDFDirect.exe`, to load a malicious DLL named `PDFCORE8.dll`.

attack_patterns.name: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation
attack_patterns.description: The malware payload `PDFCORE8.dll` exploited vulnerable kernel drivers, specifically `BootRepair.sys` and `EnPortv.sys`, to gain elevated system privileges.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The `PDFCORE8.dll` payload terminates security processes on the compromised host to evade detection.

attack_patterns.name: Process Hollowing
attack_patterns.description: The malware unhooks NTDLL functions to bypass EDR monitoring, a defense evasion technique the report associates with process hollowing.

attack_patterns.name: Modify Registry
attack_patterns.description: The final ValleyRAT payload is stored within the system registry to establish a resilient persistence mechanism.

malware.name: ValleyRAT
malware.description: An advanced, dual-layer remote access trojan deployed as the final payload by SilverFox. It provides full remote control over the compromised system for data exfiltration and lateral movement.

malware.name: PDFCORE8.dll
malware.description: A malicious DLL loader used by SilverFox, side-loaded by legitimate executables. It is a modular payload responsible for privilege escalation, disabling security tools, and unhooking NTDLL functions before deploying the final ValleyRAT payload.

tools.name: ConvertToPDF.exe
tools.description: A legitimate executable abused by SilverFox to side-load the malicious `PDFCORE8.dll`.

tools.name: PDFDirect.exe
tools.description: A legitimate executable abused by SilverFox for DLL side-loading of its malicious payload.

tools.name: BootRepair.sys
tools.description: A known-vulnerable kernel driver exploited by the `PDFCORE8.dll` payload to achieve privilege escalation.

tools.name: EnPortv.sys
tools.description: A known-vulnerable kernel driver exploited by the `PDFCORE8.dll` payload to achieve privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.name: Vulnerable Kernel Drivers for Privilege Escalation
vulnerabilities.description: The malware exploited vulnerable kernel drivers, specifically BootRepair.sys and EnPortv.sys, to achieve privilege escalation on the compromised system.

identities.name: Japanese industrial manufacturing company
identities.description: A company in the Japanese industrial manufacturing sector targeted by the SilverFox APT for cyber-espionage.

identities.name: QQ
identities.description: A legitimate cloud service abused by SilverFox to host and deliver malicious payloads, bypassing initial security filters.

identities.name: Tencent Cloud
identities.description: A legitimate cloud service abused by SilverFox to host and deliver malicious payloads, bypassing initial security filters.

infrastructure.name: Malicious Content Hosting on Legitimate Cloud Services
infrastructure.description: SilverFox used legitimate cloud services like QQ and Tencent Cloud to host malicious payloads, making the download appear benign to security filters.

indicators.name: SilverFox Malicious File Indicators
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: SilverFox Malicious File Creation
id: 2b1a9c8d-f3e4-4b5a-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files associated with the SilverFox APT campaign, including the primary loader and vulnerable drivers.
references:
  - https://securityaffairs.com/196347/apt/silverfox-targets-japanese-manufacturer-with-advanced-valleyrat-campaign.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-31
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1068
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '\PDFCORE8.dll'
      - '\BootRepair.sys'
      - '\EnPortv.sys'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the presence of malicious files used in the SilverFox campaign, including the loader DLL and vulnerable drivers.

indicators.name: SilverFox DLL Sideloading Pattern
indicators.pattern:
title: SilverFox DLL Sideloading via ConvertToPDF.exe
id: 9a8b7c6d-5e4f-4a3b-2c1d-0e9f8a7b6c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the legitimate 'ConvertToPDF.exe' process loading the malicious 'PDFCORE8.dll', a TTP of the SilverFox APT group.
references:
  - https://securityaffairs.com/196347/apt/silverfox-targets-japanese-manufacturer-with-advanced-valleyrat-campaign.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-31
tags:
  - attack.t1574.002
level: high
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\ConvertToPDF.exe'
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\PDFCORE8.dll'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the specific DLL side-loading technique used by SilverFox where `ConvertToPDF.exe` loads `PDFCORE8.dll`.

indicators.name: SilverFox Vulnerable Driver Load for Privilege Escalation

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-31
tags:
  - attack.t1068
level: high
logsource:
  category: image_load
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
      - '\BootRepair.sys'
      - '\EnPortv.sys'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the loading of known-vulnerable kernel drivers used by SilverFox to escalate privileges.
